paper_title: Absorption of light dark matter in semiconductors

coupling_convention: kinetic mixing kappa (chi), dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Projection paper (Hochberg, Lin, Zurek 2017) for absorption of kinetically mixed hidden-photon dark matter in Ge/Si semiconductors, 1 kg-yr, 90% CL. Fig. 2 shows kappa vs mV. Values approximate reading of Ge halo-DM reach curve (multi-phonon below ~0.2 eV, electron excitation above 0.5 eV); no numerical table provided. Paper also derives recast limits from CDMSlite/DAMIC/Xenon100. A separate pseudoscalar (AxionElectron, g_aee) result is in Fig. 3.
